_note: Session profiles example for ~/.pi/agent/braid/config.json (the braid config file, read fresh per session start). The first entry whose cwd matches the session directory — the directory itself or anything under it; ~ expands against home — classifies the session. hint is a one-shot steer the skills tool delivers on the session's first non-empty prompt. name: 1-64 chars of [A-Za-z0-9._-], starting alphanumeric. Entries failing the shape are dropped whole.

sessionProfiles.name: work
sessionProfiles.hint: Sessions under this directory are for the work monorepo; keep assumptions, conventions, and priorities anchored there.
